summary: The diff implements most of the FloatingWhatsApp requirements. REQ-1 through REQ-4 are largely satisfied, but there is one notable gap: REQ-1 specifies 48×48px on mobile, but the component only uses a fixed w-14 h-14 (56×56px) with no responsive size variant for mobile. REQ-4's AC that 'the button does not render if no number is available at all' is only partially addressed since the component always renders due to the hardcoded fallback. An undocumented pulse/ping animation ring was also added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Button should be 48x48px on mobile and 56x56px on desktop
missing_requirements.reason: The component only applies a fixed w-14 h-14 (56x56px) class with no responsive Tailwind size variant for mobile screens such as 'w-12 h-12 md:w-14 md:h-14'.

hallucinated_features.description: Continuously pulsing animate-ping ring around the WhatsApp button
hallucinated_features.reason: A pulsing ring element using animate-ping was added to the button. This was not requested in any requirement; only an entrance animation (REQ-3) and hover scale/glow (REQ-2) were specified.
